description_en: Modifies the annotation of an API asset in the API security module of Web Application Firewall (WAF)
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-apisec-api-resource --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --api-id c68995b89069595c5c0399676f3ca64f --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyApisecApiResource

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html获取当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to follow the API asset. Valid values:

1: follows the API asset.

0 (default): does not follow the API asset
parameters.help_zh:
是否关注。取值：
1：表示关注。
0：表示不关注（默认）
parameters.name: follow

parameters.help_en: The remarks of the API asset. You can use this parameter to add a custom annotation to the API asset for easier identification
parameters.name: note

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API asset that you want to modify
parameters.name: api_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

This parameter is required only for hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html operation to query the ID of the hybrid cloud cluster
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group to which the WAF instance belongs
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
